text.description_html:
Brass Accents A07-K6550, Traditional Door Knocker

The Traditional 6 Inch Door Knocker has a classic look that has made it a favorite among homeowners and designers alike over the years. The traditional design lends itself well to almost any setting. This front door knocker comes packaged with the installation hardware.

Brass Accents provides distinctive craftsmanship with old-world tradition for a lifetime of elegance. Brass Accents Door Knockers are hand finished in the USA. They are one of the world's leading crafters of cast-brass and hot-forged decorative brass hardware.

Specifications of the Brass Accents A07-K6550 Traditional Front Door Knocker:

  • Height: 6"
  • Width: 3"
  • Projection: 1"
  • Mounting Centers: 4"
  • Solid Brass

No matter which finish you choose for the outside, it will still be solid brass material inside.
